_doc: THIRTEEN asset manifest. Every runtime asset is listed with provenance. status: production | test | missing. Only 'production' assets may ship as final art. A 'missing' asset falls back to the procedural rig and is reported, never silently substituted. Every asset lists its components (base character, clothing, hair, textures, animations) with source, license, licenseUrl and verified:true only after the exact license text was checked. An asset cannot become 'production' unless every component is verified (enforced by tools/tests/core.test.js).
